conditionDescriptions.charged: Chaque fois que vous subissez des dégâts de foudre, vous êtes Surchargé pendant 1 minute.
conditionDescriptions.charmed: Considère le charmeur comme un allié. Le charmeur a l'avantage sur les interactions sociales avec vous.

conditionDescriptions.dead: Vous mourrez lorsque vous avez subi 6 Blessures (sauf si vous avez une capacité qui modifie ce nombre). Il existe des moyens de ressusciter un héros qui est mort, mais ils sont rares et souvent coûteux.
conditionDescriptions.despair: Désavantage sur la prochaine attaque que vous effectuez dans ce combat.
conditionDescriptions.distracted: Une cible est distraite si elle est adjacente à un allié qui vous provoque, ou si elle ne peut pas vous voir.
conditionDescriptions.dying: À 0PV. Subir des dégâts en étant mourant cause 2 Blessures, un critique en cause 3.
conditionDescriptions.frightened: Désavantage sur les jets quand la source de la peur est proche ; vitesse réduite de moitié quand vous vous approchez d'elle.
conditionDescriptions.grappled: Ne peut pas bouger. Les attaques contre vous ont l'avantage.
conditionDescriptions.hampered: Toute créature dont les actions ou le mouvement sont réduits (ex. Étourdi, Aggrippé, À terre, Terrain difficile).
conditionDescriptions.incapacitated: Ne peut rien faire. Les attaques contre vous ont l'avantage, et les attaques de mêlée qui touchent, critiquent.
conditionDescriptions.invisible: Ne peut pas être vu. Vos attaques ont l'avantage, et les attaques contre vous ont un désavantage.
conditionDescriptions.lastStand: At 0 HP, the legendary monster is dying and gains dangerous new capabilities. They finally die after a small amount of additional damage.
conditionDescriptions.latched: You move where your target moves until either dies. Your attacks cannot miss. Attacks that miss you damage your target instead.
conditionDescriptions.marked: Marked as a quarry by another creature. That creature treats this one as a tracked target; any resulting bonuses come from the marker's own features, not this condition.
conditionDescriptions.paralyzed: Incapacité. Ne peut rien faire. Les attaques contre vous ont l'avantage, et les attaques de mêlée qui touchent, critiquent.
conditionDescriptions.petrified: Incapacité. Vous avez tous les bénéfices et inconvénients d'être un rocher ! Immunisé à la plupart des dégâts sauf ceux causés par de grandes explosions, des pioches ou des outils similaires.
conditionDescriptions.prone: Le déplacement coûte deux fois plus cher, et vous avez un désavantage sur les attaques. Les attaques de mêlée contre vous ont l'avantage ; les attaques à distance ont un désavantage. Dépensez 3 espaces de votre Vitesse pour vous relever.
conditionDescriptions.restrained: Ne peut pas bouger. Les attaques contre vous ont l'avantage.
conditionDescriptions.riding: Vous vous déplacez avec la créature sur laquelle vous êtes monté. Toute attaque qui vous touche, touche la créature.
conditionDescriptions.silenced: Ne peut pas lancer de sorts ou utiliser d'autres capacités qui nécessitent de parler (ex. Ordres du Commandant).
conditionDescriptions.slowed: Vitesse réduite de moitié pendant votre prochain tour.
conditionDescriptions.smoldering: Certains sorts de feu peuvent infliger la condition Incandescent et apporter des effets destructifs supplémentaires contre les ennemis Incandescents.
conditionDescriptions.stunned: Incapacité. Ne peut rien faire. Les attaques contre vous ont l'avantage, et les attaques de mêlée qui touchent, critiquent.
conditionDescriptions.swallowed: You take 20 damage at the start of your turn. Your attacks cannot miss and ignore armor.
conditionDescriptions.taunted: Désavantage sur les attaques sauf contre le plus récent provoqueur.
conditionDescriptions.unconscious: Incapacité. Ne peut rien faire. Les attaques contre vous ont l'avantage, et les attaques de mêlée qui touchent, critiquent.
conditionDescriptions.wounded: À une ou plusieurs Blessures (typiquement 6 Blessures et un héros est mort).

value.hint: Un nombre plat, une formule (par exemple @level), ou une expression de dés.

actionCost.description: Change how many actions it costs to activate matching items or use heroic reactions. Adjust adds to the base cost (use a negative value to reduce it); Set replaces it. The final cost never drops below 0. Cost only — a free reaction is still limited to once per round.

itemIdentifier.hint: Only affect the item whose identifier matches this. Leave blank to affect all matching items.
itemIdentifier.label: Item identifier

itemTypes.hint: Only activations of these item types are affected. Leave empty to affect every item type.
itemTypes.label: Item types

mode.hint: Adjust: add the value to the base action cost (negative values reduce it). Set: replace the action cost with the value.
mode.label: How to apply

reactions.hint: Only these heroic reactions are affected. Leave empty to affect every heroic reaction.
reactions.label: Heroic reactions

value.hint: A flat number or formula (e.g. @level). Combined per the mode above.
value.label: Value

borrowFromNextTurn.hint: Also start the next turn with that many fewer actions, applied together with the immediate gain as a single adjustment.
borrowFromNextTurn.label: Borrow from next turn

actionDelta.description: Grant or remove raw actions when this item is used — immediately or at the recipient's next turn. Can also borrow: gain actions now and start the next turn with that many fewer. Applies to character combatants only.

target.hint: self: the actor using the item. targeted: the currently targeted tokens. allAllies: every allied hero in the combat.
target.label: Target

timing.hint: now: adjust the current action pool immediately (may exceed the usual maximum). nextTurn: apply when the recipient's actions next refill.
timing.label: Timing

value.hint: How many actions to grant. A flat number or formula (e.g. @level). Negative values remove actions.
value.label: Actions

applyCondition.description: Appliquer une condition de statut à une cible (ou à soi-même) lors d'un déclencheur — sur un coup, une critique, un échec, une sauvegarde ratée, le début du tour, etc.

trigger.label: Déclencheur

formula.hint: Un nombre plat ou une formule. Combinaison selon le mode ci-dessous.

anyDieCrits.hint: Any die of the roll on its max makes the attack a crit on a hit. The crit rolls the Primary Die again.
anyDieCrits.label: Any die at its max is a crit

attackSource.hint: Restrict to weapon or spell attacks. "Any" matches both.
attackSource.label: Source

cannotMiss.hint: A miss face on the Primary Die is a hit.
cannotMiss.label: The attack cannot miss

chargePoolIdentifier.hint: The pool that gives 1 charge each time the rule changes an attack. Leave empty for no limit. The rule does not run when the pool is empty.
chargePoolIdentifier.label: Charge pool

critD20.hint: The first crit die of each crit of the attack is a d20. A 20 goes on with the die of the attack. With Feature Effects off, this is a row in Change This Roll.
critD20.label: First crit die is a d20

critRange.hint: 1 makes a d8 crit on a 7 or 8. Only the face the Primary Die keeps counts. The extra dice of a crit still roll again only on the max.
critRange.label: Crit on this many less than the max

attackOutcome.description: Changes how an attack roll is read when it is made: the attack cannot miss, crits on a lower face, crits without the max, or crits when any die rolls its max. There is no choice to make. With Feature Effects off, a crit from this rule is a Make It a Crit row in Change This Roll on the card.

exceptItemIdentifier.hint: The identifier of an item whose attacks this rule ignores, such as a companion's attack. Empty ignores none.
exceptItemIdentifier.label: Not attacks with this item

forceCrit.hint: The Primary Die keeps its face, and the crit rolls it again. On a hit: a miss stays a miss.
forceCrit.label: Make the attack a crit

form.onlyWhileHint: For example, only while Raging. To test the damage type of the attack, use attack:damageType:slashing.

ignoreArmor.hint: The attack's damage ignores the target's armor.
ignoreArmor.label: Ignores armor

otherCreature.hint: For your attacks, the target. For attacks against you, the one who attacks. With two or more targets, a rule with this set does not run.
otherCreature.label: Only when the other creature is

side.hint: Your attacks, or the attacks other creatures make against you.
side.label: Which attacks does it change?

thisItemOnly.hint: Only attacks made with the item that has this rule.
thisItemOnly.label: Only attacks with this item

viciousCrits.hint: Each crit die of the attack rolls 1 more die. An attack that is Vicious stays as it is. With Feature Effects off, this is a row in Change This Roll.
viciousCrits.label: Crits are Vicious

auraReach.description: Add to the Reach of the hero's aura. Every Aura Reach rule on the hero adds up, and formulas read the total as @auraReach.

value.hint: A number or formula, in spaces. A feature that gives the aura adds its Reach (for example 4); a feature that raises it adds the raise (for example 2).
value.label: Reach

addsBonusOnSet.hint: Off: the set value is the final face, so the max is a crit and 1 is a miss. On: a Primary Die bonus is added to the set value, up to the max.
addsBonusOnSet.label: Add the Primary Die bonus to the set value

amount.hint: Added to the face the die shows. Use a negative number to take away. It cannot be 0.
amount.label: Number to add

choices.set: Set it to a value the player picks

change.hint: The die stays between 1 and its max.
change.label: How does it change the die?

chargeCost.hint: How many charges one use takes from the pool.

chargePoolIdentifier.hint: The pool it spends charges from. Leave empty for no limit. The button does not show when the pool is empty.

changeDie.description: Lets the one who rolled, the target of an attack, or an ally change one die of an attack, a save or a check after it is made: set it to a value the player picks, or add a number to it. Crit and miss are worked out again.

die.hint: On a save or a check, the Primary Die is the d20. The player picks the die when they use it.
die.label: Which die does it change?

oncePerRoll.hint: The feature can change a die of the same attack, save or check only once, even with uses left.
oncePerRoll.label: Only once per roll

rowPerUpcastStep.hint: The roll gets one row for each upcast step of the spell, and none with no upcast.
rowPerUpcastStep.label: One row per upcast step

yieldsTo.hint: The identifier of a rule of the same creature. While that rule can be used, this row does not show. Empty for none.
yieldsTo.label: Gives way to

choices.add: Add a formula to the total
choices.countsAsNat20: A result of 1 or less counts as a natural 20
choices.setTotal: Set the total to a formula

change.hint: The roll on the card stays what the dice gave. A reroll takes a change of a total or a success off, and its cost stays paid. No damage needs Attack as the roll and The target as who can use it. A natural 20 is for saves and skill checks, costs nothing and needs no click; with Feature Effects off it is a row.
change.label: How does it change the result?

chargeCost.hint: How many charges one use takes from the pool.

chargePoolIdentifier.hint: The pool it spends charges from. Leave empty for no limit. The row does not show when the pool is empty.

changeResult.description: Changes the result of a roll after it is made: a save, a check or Initiative succeeds, its total becomes a formula, or a formula goes on its total. A target can take no damage from an attack. A low result can count as a natural 20 by itself. The player can take a clicked change back and gets its uses, Mana and Wounds back.

formula.hint: A number or a formula with no dice, read from the one who rolled, such as 10+@intelligence or @strength. A formula that is only one stat shows that stat on the row, such as Add +3 STR.
formula.label: Formula

onlyIfLower.hint: The row shows only when the total on the card is below the formula's value.
onlyIfLower.label: Only if the total is lower

outcome.hint: With A failed roll, the row goes away when the card says Succeeded, and shows when the card knows no result, because the system cannot tell.
outcome.label: The first roll is

allowFree.hint: The roll window gets a tick, off at first, to use the item and spend no charge, for a use that another feature makes free. The system changes nothing else of that use: what a free use does not give stays with the player.
allowFree.label: Use without a charge

cost.hint: Charges spent per activation. In variable mode this is the smallest amount the player may choose.
cost.label: Cost

costMode.hint: Fixed spends the cost every activation. Variable asks the player how much to spend, from the cost up to the maximum, and the item’s effect formulas read the chosen amount as @spent.
costMode.label: Cost mode

chargeConsumer.description: Dépenser des charges à partir d'un pool d'objet ou de personnage lorsque le propriétaire de cette règle est activé.

maxCost.hint: Variable mode only. Ceiling formula for the player’s choice. Leave blank to allow the pool’s remaining charges.
maxCost.label: Maximum cost

chargePool.description: Définir un pool de charges rechargeable (par objet ou personnage) avec un ou plusieurs déclencheurs de récupération.

dieSize.hint: Facultatif. Défini lorsque les charges sont dépensées en lançant un dé (par exemple, Dés de Combat). Laisser vide pour les compteurs simples.
dieSize.label: Taille du dé

hidden.hint: Track and enforce the pool without showing it. Use this for a pool that only rate-limits or gates the feature, so it does not read as a second budget next to the pool the player actually spends.
hidden.label: Hide from sheet

hideMax.hint: For a pool the book gives no cap. The maximum stays only as a limit, and the sheet and the card show the count alone.
hideMax.label: Show the count with no maximum

initial.hint: Lorsque le pool démarre plein ou vide lorsqu'il est d'abord accordé.
initial.label: Initial

max.hint: Formule de capacité. Plat (3), formule (@key), ou données d'acteur (@strength).
max.label: Charges Max

recoveries.hint: Lorsque et comment les charges sont restaurées. Ajoutez une entrée par déclencheur.
recoveries.label: Récupérations

mode.hint: Comment la valeur s'applique : "add" (gagner N), "set" (mettre à N), ou "refresh" (remplir jusqu'au max).
mode.label: Mode

needsFeatureEffects.hint: With Feature Effects off, this recovery does nothing. The player uses + and - on the pool.
needsFeatureEffects.label: Needs Feature Effects

notWhenSpent.hint: A use that spends from this pool gains nothing from this recovery.
notWhenSpent.label: Not from a use that spends

predicate.hint: Optional condition tested when the trigger fires (e.g. self: fullHp). Leave empty to always apply.
predicate.label: Only while

temporary.hint: Only on a charge pool, with the Add mode. These uses are spent first. They go away when the encounter ends.
temporary.label: Temporary uses

trigger.hint: Évènement qui déclenche cette récupération (type de repos, événement d'encounter, coup, etc.).
trigger.label: Déclencheur

value.hint: Montant utilisé par le mode. Plat ou formule. Ignoré lorsque le mode est "refresh".
value.label: Valeur

scope.hint: Où le pool vit. Les pools "Item" vivent sur cet objet ; les pools "Actor" vivent sur le personnage et peuvent être partagés par des fonctionnalités qui référencent le même identifiant.
scope.label: Scope

showAsResource.hint: Also show the pool in the sheet header, alongside mana and the other standing resources. Use this for a pool the player spends and plans around. A pool hidden from the sheet is never shown here.
showAsResource.label: Show as a resource

combatMana.description: Octroyer une ressource de mana lors d'un déclencheur de combat et la vider lors d'un événement configurable.

concentrationTrack.description: Track concentration on the named spell schools separately, so the actor can concentrate on one spell from each at the same time.

schools.hint: Each school named here gets a concentration of its own. Naming schools splits the caster's single concentration rather than adding one, so casting in a school no rule names ends every concentration they hold.
schools.label: Tracked separately

conditions.hint: L'acteur est complètement immunisé contre ces conditions et ne peut pas être affecté par elles.
conditions.label: Immunisé à

conditionImmunity.description: Rendre l'acteur immunisé contre une ou plusieurs conditions nommées.

advantage.hint: Stacks of advantage offered as one option. 0 means advantage is not offered.
advantage.label: Advantage stacks

damageBonus.hint: Damage offered as the other option. Flat (5), formula (@level), or dice (1d6). Leave blank to not offer damage.
damageBonus.label: Damage bonus

damageType.hint: Damage type applied when the damage option is chosen. Leave blank to match the attack.
damageType.label: Damage type

delivery.hint: Restrict to melee or ranged attacks. "Any" matches both.
delivery.label: Delivery

conditionalBonus.description: Offer the wielder a per-attack choice of advantage or bonus damage when a target condition is met (e.g. a Hunter's quarry). Nothing applies automatically — the activation dialog surfaces the choice.

doubleFor.hint: The attacks with an item in this list double the damage of this bonus.
doubleFor.label: Doubled for

onlyNoArmor.hint: Doubled only when the target has no armor.
onlyNoArmor.label: Only with no armor

source.hint: Restrict to weapon or spell attacks. "Any" matches both.
source.label: Source

targetCondition.hint: Predicate evaluated against the target's state at activation. The choice is only offered when the target matches, e.g. { "$and": ["target:quarry"] }.
targetCondition.label: Target condition

critBack.description: After the damage of this item is applied, the GM gets a card for each creature that lives. The chosen attack is free, targets the owner and is a crit. With Feature Effects off, nothing happens by itself.

critDice.description: A crit of the attack rolls these dice as a line of their own on the attack card. The dice do not explode and are not Vicious. With Feature Effects off, this is a row in Change This Roll.

dieRole.hint: What other features call these dice.
dieRole.label: Name of the dice

oncePerTurn.hint: Once per turn of any creature. A new roll that takes the crit away gives the use back.
oncePerTurn.label: 1/turn

chargePoolIdentifier.hint: The pool it spends a charge from. Leave empty for no limit.
chargePoolIdentifier.label: Charge pool

critDiceSave.description: A row in Change This Roll on an attack with dice a crit adds. It spends a use, and the target makes a save on a normal save card. A failed save sets the dice to their max. A passed save gives the use back.

saveDC.hint: The DC of the save, as a formula of your stats.
saveDC.label: DC

amount.hint: The damage the owner took, or what the attack's crit dice came to.
amount.label: Amount

damageBack.description: When the owner takes damage from an attack (a crit, unless you turn off Only against crits), the one who attacked takes the same amount, ignoring armor. It goes on the card when the damage is applied. With Feature Effects off, the card shows a button.

onlyCrits.hint: Give damage back only when the attack is a crit.
onlyCrits.label: Only against crits

woundDoubles.hint: The owner can suffer 1 Wound to deal the amount one more time.
woundDoubles.label: A Wound doubles it

damageType.hint: Restreindre aux attaques de ce type. Laisser vide pour correspondre à toutes.
damageType.label: Type de dégâts

delivery.hint: Restreindre aux attaques de mêlée ou à distance. "Toutes" correspondent aux deux.
delivery.label: Touche

damageBonus.description: Ajouter un bonus plat, une formule ou une expression de dé à la dégâts infligés par les attaques d'un type donné (mêlée/portée) et d'une source donnée (arme/sort).

itemIdentifier.hint: The identifier of the item, such as lifebinding-spirit. Empty is every item.
itemIdentifier.label: Only attacks with this item

source.hint: Restreindre aux attaques d'arme ou de sort. "Toutes" correspondent aux deux.
source.label: Source

targetCondition.hint: Prédicat optionnel évalué contre l'état de la cible. Le bonus s'applique uniquement lorsque la cible correspond. Utilisez $and / $or avec des chaînes atomiques, par exemple { "$or": ["target:bloodied", "target:concentrating"] }.
targetCondition.label: Condition de la cible

damageMultiplier.description: A tick in the roll window of this item that multiplies its damage. The label says when it applies. The player decides, and the system checks nothing.

multiplier.hint: A whole number, 2 or more. The tick starts off, and a roll with no window does not use it.
multiplier.label: Multiply the damage by

damageTypes.hint: Restrict to these damage types. Leave empty to reduce all incoming damage.
damageTypes.label: Damage types

damageReduction.description: Reduce incoming damage by a flat or formula-based amount, or halve it (resistance), optionally scoped to specific damage types. Applied after armor, before temporary hit points.

mode.hint: Flat subtracts the reduction value. Half halves the damage instead (resistance); halving applies once no matter how many matching sources the actor has.
mode.label: Mode

onlyCrits.hint: Reduce the damage only when the attack is a crit. All the damage of the crit is reduced.
onlyCrits.label: Only against crits

value.hint: A flat number (5) or formula (@abilities.str.mod). Dice expressions are not supported.
value.label: Reduction

actionCost.hint: The actions one use spends in combat.
actionCost.label: Actions

alsoInterpose.hint: The tick also goes with an Interpose and no Defend. Its cost, reroll and reminder work; what it does to the Defend does not.
alsoInterpose.label: Also when you Interpose

armorBonus.hint: A formula for the armor this Defend adds, for example @key. Empty adds none.
armorBonus.label: More armor

choices.attackerTurn: At the start of the attacker's next turn

attackerConditionEnds.hint: When the condition on the attacker ends.
attackerConditionEnds.label: Condition ends

chargeCost.hint: How many charges one use spends.
chargeCost.label: Charges

chargePoolIdentifier.hint: The charges one use spends. Empty spends none.
chargePoolIdentifier.label: Charge pool

defendOption.description: Something this hero can do with a Defend. With Defend is a tick under the Defend rows of the Defend window. Free Defend is a row of its own. Second Defend lets the hero Defend one more time each round. When an Ally Defends is a button on the attack card for this hero.

dicePoolIdentifier.hint: One use expends every die of this dice pool, and needs at least one die in it. Undo gives the dice back.
dicePoolIdentifier.label: Expend a dice pool

oncePerTurn.hint: One use each turn, of any creature. The options on the same item share it.
oncePerTurn.label: 1/turn

otherCreature.hint: Tests the creature that made the attack. Pick tags such as target:quarry, which only the hero who marked it sees. Empty means any attacker.
otherCreature.label: Only when the attacker is

outcome.hint: The attack misses and No damage: the hero takes no damage. Halve: the hero takes half the damage, in place of the armor.
outcome.label: Damage

range.hint: How near the ally who Defends must be. A number or formula, for example @auraReach for the hero's aura.
range.label: Range (spaces)

reminder.hint: A line on the attack card for what the table does, for example a move or an attack back.
reminder.label: Reminder

upcastArmor.hint: The armor this Defend adds for each step the item is upcast.
upcastArmor.label: More armor per upcast

useItem.hint: The row uses this item, with its own costs, for example a spell's mana and action.
useItem.label: Use this item

useReroll.hint: Rerolls the attack with this item's Reroll rule. Its Change This Roll row does not show on the card.
useReroll.label: Use this item's reroll

way.hint: With Defend: a tick the player can add to a Defend. Free Defend: a row that Defends with no action; it still uses the Defend for the round. Second Defend: the hero can Defend one more time each round, until their next turn begins. When an Ally Defends: a button after an ally within range Defends.
way.label: Shows as

wholeRound.hint: This Defend also covers each later attack on the hero this round, with nothing more to spend.
wholeRound.label: Every attack this round

withInterpose.hint: The free Defend shows only with an Interpose, as Interpose and Defend.
withInterpose.label: Only when you Interpose

woundCost.hint: The Wounds one use gives the hero.
woundCost.label: Wounds

bonusOnAttackDelivery.hint: Restrict this consumer to melee or ranged attacks. Applies to both an auto-bonus pool and a card offer. Leave empty (or pick "any") for no restriction. Beware: an activation with no attack type set counts as neither melee nor ranged, so most spells and utility features are excluded by any restriction here, with nothing shown to explain why.
bonusOnAttackDelivery.label: Attack delivery

cardOffer.hint: Also offer this spend as a button on the owner's own attack cards, adding the result to that card's damage instead of posting a separate roll. "Hit" offers it on any hit, "Critical Hit" only on a crit. Leave empty to offer the spend through the sheet's dice pool panel only. Requires a manual spend that consumes dice for a generic effect.
cardOffer.label: Offer on attack card

damageType.hint: The damage type a card offer's bonus deals. Leave empty to inherit the attack's own type, which folds the bonus into the attack's damage total. Setting a type adds the bonus as a separate damage packet with its own Apply Damage button, so the target's flat reduction and resistance resolve against it on their own. Ignored unless the spend is offered on an attack card.
damageType.label: Bonus damage type

diceConsumer.description: Dépenser ou appliquer automatiquement des dés à partir d'un pool de dés d'objet ou de personnage. Le mode "Manual" invite le joueur à l'activation ; le mode "Auto-bonus" ajoute chaque face de dé lancé aux attaques qualifiantes sans consommer le pool.

effectType.hint: What a manual spend's effect roll produces. "Generic" posts the total to chat; "Damage Reduction" also banks the total as a one-shot reduction applied to the next damage taken.
effectType.label: Effect type

selectionOutcome.hint: What happens to the dice the player picks. "Consume" removes them from the pool; "Maximize" leaves them in place and raises each to the die's highest face, limited to the cost.
selectionOutcome.label: Selection outcome

dicePool.description: Définir un pool de dés rechargables (chaque dé stocke sa face lancée). Utilisé pour les pools de dégâts cumulatifs (Dés de Fureur) et les ressources lancées (Dés de Jugement).

dieSize.hint: Taille de chaque dé stocké dans le pool.
dieSize.label: Taille du dé

initial.hint: Le pool démarre-t-il plein (pré-lancé jusqu'au max) ou vide lorsqu'il est d'abord accordé.
initial.label: Initial

max.hint: Nombre maximum de dés que le pool peut contenir. Plat (3), formule (@key), ou données d'acteur (@strength).
max.label: Dés max

refills.hint: Lorsque et comment les charges sont restaurées. Ajoutez une entrée par déclencheur.
refills.label: Recharges

mode.hint: Comment la valeur s'applique : "add" (gagner N), "set" (mettre à N), ou "refresh" (remplir jusqu'au max).
mode.label: Mode

predicate.hint: Optional condition tested when the trigger fires (e.g. self: raging). Leave empty to always apply.
predicate.label: Condition

trigger.hint: Évènement qui déclenche cette récupération (type de repos, événement d'encounter, coup, etc.).
trigger.label: Déclencheur

value.hint: Montant utilisé par le mode. Plat ou formule. Ignoré lorsque le mode est "refresh".
value.label: Valeur

scope.hint: Où le pool vit. Les pools "Item" vivent sur cet objet ; les pools "Actor" vivent sur l'acteur et peuvent être partagés par les fonctionnalités qui référencent le même identifiant.
scope.label: Scope

dyingActionLimit.description: Set the maximum number of actions the actor may take while Dying. The highest applicable limit wins, so it never lowers the baseline of 1.

value.hint: A flat number or formula (e.g. 2). Use a predicate such as { "$and": ["self:dying"] } to apply only while Dying.
value.label: Action limit

berserker.rageEndConfirm: Are you sure you want to end Rage? Your Fury Dice will be lost.

chargePoolIdentifier.hint: The pool it spends a charge from.
chargePoolIdentifier.label: Charge pool

freeAssess.description: Using the item opens Assess, free and with advantage. It spends a charge when there is one. With none, it costs nothing.

chargePoolIdentifier.hint: Optional. When set, the rule lets the creature move for free only while this charge pool has a charge, and each card it posts spends 1 charge. Leave empty for no limit.
chargePoolIdentifier.label: Charge pool

freeMove.description: Let a creature move for free, on a chat card, when an event occurs. The player chooses where to move, or chooses not to move.

direction.hint: any: in any direction. away: away from this creature. toward: toward this creature.
direction.label: Direction

distance.hint: How many spaces the creature can move. A formula: @speed is the speed of the creature that moves, and all other references use the data of this creature.
distance.label: Distance

ignoresDifficultTerrain.hint: When set, difficult terrain does not decrease the move.
ignoresDifficultTerrain.label: Ignores difficult terrain

poolIdentifier.hint: The dice pool that must gain dice (e.g. fury).
poolIdentifier.label: Dice pool

recipient.hint: Who can move for free. self: this creature. allies: each ally within the set number of spaces. selfAndAllies: this creature and each ally within that number of spaces.
recipient.label: Recipient

trigger.hint: The event that lets the creature move for free. onActivation: this item is used. onPoolGain: a dice pool gains dice. onInitiativeRolled: this creature rolls Initiative. onTurnStart: the turn of this creature starts. onCritReceived: this creature takes a critical hit. afterPoolDiceToMax: a Pool Die to Max rule of this item fires.
trigger.label: Trigger

whisper.hint: When set, only the feature's owner, the players whose creatures get the move, and the GM see the card. When not set, everyone sees it.
whisper.label: Whisper the card

within.hint: The maximum number of spaces between this creature and an ally that can move for free. 0 means all allies on the scene.
within.label: Allies within (spaces)

activationType.hint: What the recipient is offered. Weapon attack: the recipient picks one of their weapons and makes a normal attack.
activationType.label: Granted activation

grantActivation.description: Offer the currently targeted tokens an immediate activation (e.g. a weapon attack) via a button on this item's chat card. Any action cost for the recipient is governed by other rules, such as an Action Cost or Action Adjustment rule.

includesUser.hint: The user of the item gets an offer row too.
includesUser.label: Also for the user

grantItem.description: Octroyer un objet par UUID lorsque le propriétaire de cette règle est créé sur un acteur. Gestion optionnelle des doublons et remplacement de la quantité.

inMemoryOnly.label: Ne pas persister dans l'inventaire de l'acteur

grantMovement.description: Octroyer un mode de déplacement de base (marcher, voler, grimper, nager, ou creuser). Les octrois multiples du même mode prennent le plus haut ; les bonus de vitesse s'empilent.

mode.hint: Le mode de déplacement à octroyer.
mode.label: Mode de déplacement

speed.hint: Vitesse de base pour ce mode. Utilisez une formule comme @attributes.movement.walk pour correspondre à la vitesse de marche, ou un nombre comme 12.
speed.label: Valeur

grantProficiency.description: Octroyer la maîtrise en armure, armes ou langues. Utilisez ‘all’ pour octroyer toutes les valeurs du type choisi.

displayAs.hint: Languages only: the name this item's ancestry uses for the granted language (e.g. a Gnome calls Dwarvish "Gnomish"). Leave blank to use the language's normal name.
displayAs.label: Display As

grantSpells.description: Octroyer des sorts par filtre d'école + niveau, par UUID, ou par choix de l'utilisateur.

uuids.hint: Faites glisser les sorts d'un compendium ou de la barre latérale vers chaque emplacement pour les octroyer directement.
uuids.label: Sorts spécifiques

healingPotionBonus.description: Ajouter un bonus plat ou basé sur une formule à la guérison reçue à partir de potions.

hitCondition.description: When the damage of this item is applied, a creature gets a condition. A condition on the attacker also stores the creature that was hit. With Feature Effects off, the GM applies the condition by hand.

recipient.hint: The creature that was hit, or the attacker.
recipient.label: Who gets it

when.hint: On any hit, or only on a crit.
when.label: When

amount.hint: 1 = normal advantage (roll 2, keep highest). 2 = advantage 2 (roll 3, keep highest).
amount.label: Advantage Level

condition.hint: Optional narrative condition shown to the player (e.g. ‘in the wild’). Field-rest rules appear as a toggle during a rest.
condition.label: Condition

hitDiceAdvantage.description: Octroyer un avantage sur les jets de dés de vie sous une condition narrative spécifique (e.g., ‘in the wild’).

rollContext.hint: Which hit-dice roll the advantage modifies: field-rest healing or the max-HP increase when leveling up.
rollContext.label: Applies To

damageType.hint: The type of a one-use vulnerability, such as fire. With no type, the target holds no vulnerability.
damageType.label: Damage type

holdOnTarget.description: A use of this item that does not miss puts a Held Change on each target. It lasts until spent, or until the combat ends. Nothing is held outside combat. A new roll that turns the hit into a miss takes the holds back, and a new hit gives them.

choices.mustAttackOther: Next attack against the closest other creature
choices.vulnerableOnce: Vulnerable to the next damage of this type

heldKind.hint: A line on the next attack of the target, or a vulnerability that the next damage of one type ends.
heldKind.label: What the target holds

incrementHitDice.description: Augmenter la taille des dés de vie de l'acteur (e.g. d8 → d10) par un montant plat ou une formule.

initiativeBonus.description: Ajouter un bonus plat ou basé sur une formule à l'initiative de l'acteur.

initiativeMana.description: Rolling Initiative gives mana that ends with the combat. The dice show on the Initiative card. With Feature Effects off, a button on the card gives the mana.

dice.hint: As 1d4. Leave empty for no dice.
dice.label: Dice

initiativeManaRerollOnes.description: Each 1 on an Initiative Mana die rolls again one time. With Feature Effects off, the card has a row for each 1.

initiativeMessage.description: Afficher un message lors du jet d'initiative. Supporte l'interpolation `{value}` à partir d'une formule.

initiativeRollMode.description: Fixe ou ajuste le mode de jet d'initiative par défaut de l'acteur (avantage/désavantage).

keepAmount.description: A row on the owner's card with a hit, 1/turn. It keeps the damage total of that card. The owner's next attack this turn uses that amount: no die is rolled, no modifier is added, it is a hit with no crit. Armor applies as normal.

chargeCost.hint: How many charges one use takes from the pool.

chargePoolIdentifier.hint: The pool it spends charges from. Leave empty for no limit. The button does not show when the pool is empty.

makeCrit.description: Lets the one who rolled, the target of an attack, or an ally make an attack a crit after it is rolled. The Primary Die keeps its face and the crit dice are rolled. The crit stays for the card: a reroll or a change after it alters only the damage dice. It does not show on an attack with 2 or more targets, on an area attack, or on an attack that is already a crit.

outcome.hint: Any result also includes a miss. An attack that is a crit cannot be made a crit.
outcome.label: The attack is

usedBy.hint: The one who rolled the attack, the creature the attack is against, or an ally of the one who rolled (a friendly creature, not yourself).

markTarget.description: On activation, mark the targeted creature(s) as a tracked mark on this actor (e.g. a Hunter's quarry). Stored relationally so the matching target:<key> predicate resolves only for this actor, with an optional visible status condition on each target. Marking beyond capacity evicts the oldest; there is no time-based expiry.

endsAtEncounterEnd.hint: The marks end when the encounter ends. Taking the marker off a creature ends its mark at any time.
endsAtEncounterEnd.label: Ends at the end of the encounter

flagKey.hint: Identifier for this mark list. Attacks against a marked target expose the predicate tag target:<key> (e.g. "quarry" gives target:quarry).
flagKey.label: Flag key

maxTargets.hint: How many creatures can be marked at once. Marking beyond this evicts the oldest. 0 means unlimited.
maxTargets.label: Max targets

statusCondition.hint: Optional condition applied to each marked target as a visible marker. Leave blank for an invisible mark.
statusCondition.label: Status condition

chargeCost.hint: How many charges one use takes from the pool.
chargeCost.label: Charges

chargePoolIdentifier.hint: The pool it spends charges from. Leave empty for no limit.
chargePoolIdentifier.label: Charge pool

maxDamage.description: Lets a creature take the max of a roll in place of rolling it. No die is rolled, so the attack cannot miss and nothing can reroll or change its dice. It is a tick in the roll window.

givesCrit.hint: On one target, the attack is a hit and a crit with no extra dice: it ignores armor and runs its crit effects. On an area or on 2 or more targets it does not crit.
givesCrit.label: It is also a crit

schools.hint: Only spells of these schools. Empty is any item.
schools.label: Spell schools

tempHpChoice.hint: The player can give that many temp HP in place of the healing.
tempHpChoice.label: Temp HP choice

maxHitDice.description: Ajouter aux dés de vie maximum de l'acteur. Cible optionnelle une taille de dé spécifique.

dieSize.label: Taille de dé (0 = défaut de classe)

maxHpBonus.description: Ajouter un bonus plat au HP maximum de l'acteur. Avec `perLevel`, le bonus évolue avec le niveau du personnage.

perLevel.hint: Lorsqu'il est activé, le bonus est appliqué par niveau (e.g. +2 par niveau → +20 au niveau 10).
perLevel.label: Multiplier par le niveau du personnage

maxWounds.description: Ajouter aux blessures maximum de l'acteur avant la mort.

maximizeHitDice.description: Fait en sorte que les jets de dés de vie prennent leur valeur maximale au lieu de rouler.

appendFormula.hint: Appended to matching consumers' effect formula as "+ (...)". Spend tokens @n (dice spent) and @sum (sum of spent faces) are available.
appendFormula.label: Append formula

modifyConsumer.description: Augment the effect formula of dice-spend consumers targeting a pool (by identifier). Typically attached to a feature that improves how another feature spends its dice.

effectTypeFilter.hint: Only modify consumers with this effect type. Leave blank to modify every consumer on the pool.
effectTypeFilter.label: Effect type filter

poolIdentifier.hint: The identifier of the pool whose consumers to modify (e.g. fury).
poolIdentifier.label: Pool identifier

poolScope.hint: The scope of the pool whose consumers to modify. Must match the pool: identifiers are only unique within a scope.
poolScope.label: Pool scope

automatic.hint: Reroll happens automatically when the attack resolves instead of offering a button. Use when you want a reroll to be mandatory.
automatic.label: Automatic

modifyIncomingAttack.description: Modify attacks made against this actor. Disadvantage, forced rerolls, and automatic misses apply when this actor is targeted; Redirect to Self offers this actor a reaction to swap in as the target when a nearby ally is attacked.

missThreshold.hint: The highest primary die result that counts as a miss against this actor. Attacks normally miss on a 1. Set 2 to make attacks miss on a 1 and a 2. If more than one rule applies, the highest value wins.
missThreshold.label: Miss threshold

modifier.hint: Disadvantage and Auto Miss apply automatically to the attack roll. Force Reroll and Redirect to Self offer an interactive prompt on the attack card.
modifier.label: Modifier

range.hint: How far away a targeted ally can be for this actor to redirect the attack to themselves. The baseline heroic Interpose reaction covers 2 spaces.
range.label: Range (spaces)

rerollTrigger.hint: Always, only when the attack hits (not a miss), or only when it is a critical hit.
rerollTrigger.label: Reroll when

rerollWithDisadvantage.hint: The forced reroll is made at disadvantage instead of a straight reroll (e.g. FAST).
rerollWithDisadvantage.label: Reroll at disadvantage

addRefills.hint: Entries this modifier contributes to the target pool, on top of the pool's own: refills on a dice pool, recoveries on a charge pool. Triggers and modes a pool type does not support are ignored, and a charge pool ignores a per-entry condition.
addRefills.label: Additional refills

mode.hint: How the value applies. On a dice pool: Add rolls that many new dice, Set rebuilds the pool to that many, Refill to max fills it, Set When Empty rebuilds it only when it is empty, and Empty the Pool removes every die. On a charge pool: Add gains that many, Set sets the pool to that many, and Refill to max fills it. A charge pool ignores Set When Empty and Empty the Pool.

modifyPool.description: Remplacer ou mettre à l'échelle un pool de dés ou de charges existant (par identifiant) — généralement attaché à une fonctionnalité d'évolution de niveau pour mettre à jour la taille des dés ou élargir le maximum.

dieSize.hint: Remplacer la taille de dé du pool ciblé. Laisser vide pour le garder inchangé.
dieSize.label: Remplacement de la taille de dé

maxDelta.hint: Montant signé ajouté au maximum du pool ciblé (e.g. "+1", "-1", "+@level"). Laisser vide pour garder le maximum inchangé.
maxDelta.label: Delta maximum

minFace.hint: Dice rolled into the target pool below this value are raised to it. Leave blank for no floor. Ignored for charge pools.
minFace.label: Minimum face

poolType.hint: Quel sous-système cibler: pools de dés (faces rouler) ou pools de charges (compteurs).
poolType.label: Type de pool

actionsForRoller.hint: The one who rolled gains this many actions immediately. This applies only in combat and only to a hero.
actionsForRoller.label: Actions for the one who rolled

cannotFail.hint: On a save or a check, the new roll succeeds, with no choice of result. On an attack, the new roll cannot miss, and it is a crit only if the die makes it a crit. It counts on each use that is clicked.
cannotFail.label: Cannot fail

modifyReroll.description: Adds to a Reroll rule on this character. It can change the new roll. It can also give actions and temp HP each time the reroll is used.

extraDamage.hint: A formula, such as 1d6 or @will. It is added to the attack's damage when its result stands. Values such as @will come from this character.
extraDamage.label: Extra damage

creatures.hint: Creatures gain these each time the reroll is used.
creatures.label: What do creatures gain?

roll.hint: These count one time per attack or check. Using the reroll again does not add them again.
roll.label: Changes to the new roll

rerollIdentifier.hint: Type the identifier of the Reroll rule to add to. That rule must be on this character.
rerollIdentifier.label: Reroll identifier

rollModeChange.hint: On the new roll. For a reroll of one die, that die is rolled two times.
rollModeChange.label: Advantage or disadvantage

tempHp.hint: The one who rolled and their allies gain this temp HP. This character does not gain it. A creature with more temp HP keeps its own. Values such as @will come from this character.
tempHp.label: Temp HP for the one who rolled and allies

tempHpWithin.hint: How many spaces a creature can be from this character's token. 0 is any distance. If this character has no token, no creature gains temp HP.
tempHpWithin.label: Reach

modifyToggle.description: Modify the behavior of a toggleEffect rule (by identifier), such as suppressing specific automatic turn-off triggers. Typically attached to a level-up feature that upgrades an earlier feature's toggle.

suppressTurnOff.hint: Turn-off events the target toggle should ignore. The toggle no longer ends automatically when these events fire.
suppressTurnOff.label: Suppress turn-off on

toggleIdentifier.hint: Identifier (or rule id) of the toggleEffect rule to modify. Matches the target rule's `identifier` field, falling back to its `id`.
toggleIdentifier.label: Toggle identifier

turnOn.hint: Events on which the target toggle switches on automatically. This rule's condition gates the turn-on, so add one to restrict when it applies.
turnOn.label: Turn on automatically on

allyRadius.hint: The maximum number of spaces between this creature and a watched ally. 0 means all allies on the scene.
allyRadius.label: Allies within (spaces)

creature.hint: selfMoved: the other creatures that the geometry is tested against. creatureMoved: the creatures whose Movement counts. enemy, ally, or any.
creature.label: Creature

movementTrigger.defaultMessage: You can use this item now.
movementTrigger.description: Post a chat card when a Movement in a started combat agrees with the conditions. The card lets the owner use this item.

event.hint: selfMoved: this creature moves. creatureMoved: a different creature moves.
event.label: Event

geometry.hint: any: no position test. endsAdjacent: the Movement stops in the Reach of the creature. enteredReach: it goes into the Reach. leftReach: it goes out of the Reach. inPath: it goes through the space of the creature. movedToward: it stops nearer to the creature than where it started.
geometry.label: Geometry

kinds.hint: The kinds of Movement that count: regular, free, and forced. By default all three count. A Teleport never counts.
kinds.label: Movement kinds

message.hint: The text on the card, under the line that says who moved and how far. You can use {mover} (the creature that moved), {spaces} (the spaces of this Movement), {spacesMovedThisTurn} (all spaces moved this turn) and {targets} (the creatures that were found). Leave empty to use the default text.
message.label: Message

minSpaces.hint: The Movement counts only when the creature moved this number of spaces or more.
minSpaces.label: Minimum spaces

minTargets.hint: The number of creatures that must agree with the geometry.
minTargets.label: Minimum creatures

observerScope.hint: self: the geometry is tested against this creature only. selfOrAllyWithin: against this creature or an ally within the set number of spaces.
observerScope.label: Watched creatures

reach.hint: The Reach, in spaces, that the geometry tests use. Reach 1 is adjacent.
reach.label: Reach

spacesScope.hint: thisTurn: all spaces moved this turn. thisMovement: the spaces of this Movement only.
spacesScope.label: Count spaces

whisper.hint: When set, only the feature's owner and the GM see the card. When not set, everyone sees it.
whisper.label: Whisper the card

note.description: Afficher un message libre sur la fiche, avec une visibilité limitée au MJ, au propriétaire, ou à tous les visionneurs.

damage.hint: A formula. The damage has the type of the attack.
damage.label: Extra damage

offerAttackBonus.description: Extra damage and a Primary Die bonus on an attack made from the row of one item. With Feature Effects off, a row in Change This Roll adds them.

offerSource.hint: The identifier of the item whose row makes the attack.
offerSource.label: Item with the row

primaryDie.hint: It changes the die, so it can give a crit or make a miss a hit.
primaryDie.label: Primary Die bonus

optionSwap.description: Offer the character a chance to swap class options they already picked, on a Safe Rest or Field Rest. The rule offers the swap; it cannot check whatever the feature asks the character to do in the fiction, so state that in the rule's label.

selectionGroups.hint: Which pools may be swapped. Use 'all' for every pool the character's class offers, which is what the class features mean by 'different <Class> options'.
selectionGroups.label: Option pools

trigger.hint: The rest that offers the swap.
trigger.label: Offered on

cardRow.hint: A row on the owner's missed spell, and on a save card where a target saved against an effect of the owner.
cardRow.label: Row on a card

optionWindow.description: Opens the window with the options of its option set. Chosen options are dimmed, and they reset at Initiative or when all were chosen.

ignoresDisadvantage.hint: Using this item takes out all disadvantage from the owner's next roll this turn.
ignoresDisadvantage.label: Ignore disadvantage

oncePerRound.hint: The window reports a second use in a round. It does not stop it.
oncePerRound.label: 1/round

opensOnUse.hint: Using this item opens the window.
opensOnUse.label: Open when used

triggerTwice.hint: The window has a tick to do the chosen option twice, and a tick to use it as a Reaction.
triggerTwice.label: Trigger twice

poolDieToMax.description: When the trigger fires, the lowest dice of a pool go to their max: one when the hero is attacked, one per Wound on a Wound.

poolIdentifier.hint: The identifier of the dice pool.
poolIdentifier.label: Pool

reach.hint: An ally this near also fires the trigger. A number or formula, for example @auraReach for the hero's aura. 0 is the hero only.
reach.label: Reach for allies

trigger.hint: onAttacked: an attack against the hero. onWound: Wounds gained.
trigger.label: Trigger

poolGainMessage.description: Post a chat reminder whenever a dice pool gains dice. Supports `{value}` interpolation from a formula.

formula.hint: Resolved against actor data and inserted into the message wherever {value} appears.
formula.label: Formula

message.hint: Chat text posted when the pool gains dice. Use {value} to insert the formula result.
message.label: Message

poolIdentifier.hint: The identifier of the dice pool whose gains trigger the message (e.g. fury).
poolIdentifier.label: Pool identifier

amount.hint: How much this item adds to the pool maximum.
amount.label: Amount

poolMaxBonus.description: Raise the maximum of a charge pool by a flat amount. The bonus lives on this item, so taking the same option twice grants two items and twice the bonus, and removing an item removes its share.

poolIdentifier.hint: The identifier of the charge pool whose maximum is raised (e.g. combat-dice).
poolIdentifier.label: Pool identifier

primaryDieBonus.description: Adds a number to the Primary Die of the owner's attack rolls, as "Add to Primary Die Result" in the attack dialog does. The die can become a crit or stop being a miss. A reroll keeps the number. Not on area attacks.

otherCreature.hint: Pick tags such as target:distracted. Empty means any target. With tags picked, an attack with no target gets nothing.
otherCreature.label: Only when the target is

value.hint: A whole number or a formula, such as 1 or @level. It can be negative. The die stops at its max and at 1: the rest is lost.
value.label: Add to the Primary Die

actionCost.hint: Only for a hero in combat. On their own turn, they spend the action now. Off their turn, their next turn starts with 1 fewer action. It is not a Heroic Reaction, so it has no 1/round limit.
actionCost.label: Action cost

actionReportOnly.hint: With no action left, the use still goes on, and the card says so.
actionReportOnly.label: No action is no block

attackDelivery.hint: Any is every attack, also an attack with no attack type, such as most spells.
attackDelivery.label: Attack type

attackSource.hint: Limit the rule to attacks with a weapon or attacks with a spell.
attackSource.label: Attack made with

automatic.hint: For text with no choice, such as "the attack is rerolled". The roll is made again at once, with no button. With Feature Effects off in Automation, a button shows instead. Not for an ally, a picked die, or a choice of result.
automatic.label: Rerolls by itself

cardHint.hint: A short note under the feature on the card, such as a limit the table checks. Empty means no note.
cardHint.label: Note on the card

cardHintWhen.hint: Pick tags, as for "Only when the other creature is". Empty means on every roll.
cardHintWhen.label: Show the note only when

chargeCost.hint: How many charges one reroll takes from the pool.
chargeCost.label: Charges per use

chargePoolIdentifier.hint: The pool it spends charges from. Leave empty for no limit. The reroll button does not show when the pool is empty.
chargePoolIdentifier.label: Charge pool

reroll.description: Lets the one who rolled, the target of an attack, or an ally reroll an attack, a save or a check, or one die of it.

die.hint: One die leaves the other dice as they are. The player picks the die when they use the reroll.
die.label: Which dice does it reroll?

discardedCritTriggers.hint: When the first roll was a crit, abilities that react to a crit still react. Damage and effects follow the new roll.
discardedCritTriggers.label: The discarded crit still triggers when-crit abilities

extraDamage.hint: A formula added to the damage of the new roll, such as 1d6 or @level. References read the owner of this feature.
extraDamage.label: Extra damage

changes.hint: The new roll keeps the first roll's advantage and disadvantage. A later reroll of the same attack, from any feature, keeps these changes too.
changes.label: Changes to the new roll (optional)

cost.hint: A use limit such as 1/Safe Rest is a charge pool on this item.
cost.label: Cost (optional)

choices.ownerChooses: The owner of this feature keeps one
choices.rollerChooses: The one who rolled keeps one

keep.hint: When a player keeps a result, nothing that depends on the roll happens until they do.
keep.label: Which result stands?

maxDice.hint: A formula. The player picks up to this many dice and confirms. Leave empty for one die.
maxDice.label: Most dice

oncePerRoll.hint: The feature can reroll the same attack, save or check only once, even with uses left.
oncePerRoll.label: Only once per roll

oncePerTurn.hint: Once per turn of any creature. Outside combat there is no limit.
oncePerTurn.label: 1/turn

otherCreature.hint: The other creature is the target of the attack, or the one who rolled when the target uses this. Pick tags such as target:distracted. Empty means any creature. It cannot be used on a roll with no other creature.
otherCreature.label: Only when the other creature is

choices.nonCriticalHit: A hit that is not a crit

outcome.hint: A hit includes a crit. A failed roll is a miss on an attack. On a save or a check, the row goes away when the card says Succeeded, and shows when the card knows no result, because the system cannot tell. The other choices are for attacks only.
outcome.label: The first roll is

perDie.hint: The cost is for each die the player picks.
perDie.label: Cost per die

primaryDieBonus.hint: A number added to the Primary Die of the new roll.
primaryDieBonus.label: Add to the Primary Die

reach.hint: How many spaces the ally can be from the one who rolled, measured when the roll is made. 0 is any distance.
reach.label: Reach

relatedStat.hint: Limits the rule to the save of that stat, the skills of that stat, the ability check of that stat, and an attack whose formula has that stat.
relatedStat.label: Related to a stat

rollModeChange.hint: Added to what the first roll had.
rollModeChange.label: Advantage or disadvantage

thisItemOnly.hint: The rule is only for attacks with the item that has it.
thisItemOnly.label: This item only

useAnotherStat.hint: A click on the row shows the other three stats, and the player picks one for the new roll. On a save it uses that stat's save modifier. On a skill check it swaps the stat part and keeps the other bonuses. On an attack it swaps the stat in the formula; an attack with no stat in its formula gets no row.
useAnotherStat.label: Use another stat

usedBy.hint: The one who rolled, the creature an attack is against, or an ally of the one who rolled (a friendly creature, not yourself). On a save or a check there is no target.
usedBy.label: Who can use it?

woundCost.hint: Wounds the user gains. 0 is none.
woundCost.label: Wounds gained per use

savingThrowBonus.description: Ajouter un bonus plat ou basé sur une formule à un ou plusieurs jets de sauvegarde. Utilisez 'all' pour l'appliquer à chaque sauvegarde.

savingThrows.hint: Choisissez une ou plusieurs sauvegardes. Utilisez "all" pour l'appliquer à chaque sauvegarde.
savingThrows.label: S'applique à

value.hint: Un nombre plat, une formule, ou une expression de dés ajoutée à la sauvegarde.
value.label: Bonus

savingThrowRollMode.description: Fixe ou ajuste le mode de lancer de sauvegarde (avantage/désavantage), en option, nécessitant un choix du joueur à l'utilisation.

requiresChoice.label: Le joueur choisit la sauvegarde à l'utilisation

abilities.hint: Pick one or more abilities. Use "all" to offer the option on every ability check.
abilities.label: Apply to abilities

checkType.hint: Which kind of roll the option appears on.
checkType.label: Offer on

situationalRollMode.description: Offer an advantage or disadvantage the roller opts into when the situation calls for it, for circumstances the system cannot detect on its own (e.g. “advantage against fear”). Nothing applies automatically: the check roll dialog lists the option and folds it into that roll only when checked. Use the rule’s label to name the situation, and its predicate for state the system already knows. Attack rolls are covered by Conditional Bonus instead.

saves.hint: Pick one or more saves. Use "all" to offer the option on every save.
saves.label: Apply to saves

skills.hint: Pick one or more skills. Use "all" to offer the option on every skill check.
skills.label: Apply to skills

value.hint: Positive values grant levels of advantage; negative values grant levels of disadvantage.
value.label: Roll mode value

skillBonus.description: Ajouter un bonus plat ou basé sur une formule à une ou plusieurs compétences. Utilisez 'all' pour l'appliquer à chaque compétence.

skills.hint: Choisissez une ou plusieurs compétences. Utilisez "all" pour l'appliquer à chaque compétence.
skills.label: S'applique à

value.hint: Un nombre plat, une formule, ou une expression de dés ajoutée à la vérification de compétence.
value.label: Bonus

skillPointMove.description: Let the character move skill points between skills on a rest. A skill may not go negative and may not exceed +12.

points.hint: How many points may be moved each time.
points.label: Points

trigger.hint: The rest that offers the move.
trigger.label: Offered on

skillRollMode.description: Set or adjust the roll mode (advantage/disadvantage) for one or more skill checks. Use ‘all’ to apply to every skill.

mode.hint: Adjust stacks with other sources; set overrides them. When mixing modes on one skill, order matters: a set that runs after an adjust discards it, so use priority to control which wins.
mode.label: How to apply

skills.hint: Pick one or more skills. Use "all" to apply to every skill.
skills.label: Apply to

value.hint: Positive values grant levels of advantage; negative values grant levels of disadvantage.
value.label: Roll mode value

speedBonus.description: Ajouter un bonus à la vitesse de l'acteur. Sans un type de mouvement explicite, s'applique à la marche ; sinon limité à la volée/la nage/la grimpe/la creuse.

movementType.hint: Laisser vide pour appliquer uniquement à la vitesse de marche. Sélectionnez un type spécifique pour le conceder ou le modifier.
movementType.label: Type de mouvement (vide = marche)

value.hint: Bonus de vitesse en cases. Les nombres négatifs réduisent la vitesse.
value.label: Bonus

tableRoll.description: A roll on the table. The system shows the table text only, and applies no effect.

choices.lessManaOrCrit: The tick for 1 less mana on a spell, or a crit (one roll per attack)

when.hint: What makes the roll. The spell dialog gets the tick for 1 less mana only from the first choice.
when.label: When

chooseChargePool.hint: A use of this pool lets the player choose one of the two rolls.
chooseChargePool.label: Pool to choose one

tableRollOptions.description: What a roll on its table can do.

rollTwice.hint: The Chaos card shows buttons before the roll.
rollTwice.label: Roll twice

table.hint: The table whose rolls these options change.
table.label: Table

clearPoolsOnEnd.hint: Pool identifiers to empty when the toggle ends, either via a turnOff trigger or the player switching it off. Use for rules like 'resources are lost when the effect ends'.
clearPoolsOnEnd.label: Clear pools on end

confirmEndPrompt.hint: When set, the explicit on/off switch shows a confirm dialog before turning the effect off. Accepts plain text or a localization key as the dialog body. Leave empty to disable the prompt.
confirmEndPrompt.label: End confirm prompt

toggleEffect.description: Player-controlled on/off switch backed by an ActiveEffect that pushes domain tags while active. Sibling rules predicate on those tags to deliver the actual bonuses.

endAfterInactiveRounds.hint: Rounds of combat inactivity after which the toggle ends at the actor's turn end. Activity means re-activating this item or activating any item with a damage effect (an attack). Leave blank to disable.
endAfterInactiveRounds.label: End after inactive rounds

endReasons.inactivity: went {rounds} round(s) without attacking or re-activating

toggleEffect.inactivityPrompt: {actor} has gone {rounds} round(s) without attacking or re-activating {name}. End it?

tags.hint: Domain tags added while the toggle is active. Sibling rules with matching predicates fire while these tags are present.

choices.onActorWounded: When the creature gets a Wound

turnOff.hint: Events that automatically toggle the effect off.
turnOff.label: Turn off on

gridDiagonalsCheck.illegal:
The core Grid Diagonals setting is {value}. Tokens cannot move diagonally, and a diagonal space counts as 2 spaces. Ranges such as Interpose (2 spaces) and Reach do not get to a diagonal space that looks near.

The book's default is that diagonals are adjacent: Equidistant (1). If your table does not treat diagonals as adjacent, use Rectilinear (2). Then tokens can move diagonally, and each diagonal step costs 2 spaces.
gridDiagonalsCheck.notInBook:
The core Grid Diagonals setting is {value}. This is not one of the book's rules for diagonal spaces. It gives a part of a space, which Nimble rounds, so ranges such as Interpose and Reach can give results that you do not expect.

The book gives three rules: diagonals are adjacent, Equidistant (1), which is the default; diagonals are not adjacent, Rectilinear (2); or every other diagonal is adjacent, Alternating (1/2/1) or Alternating (2/1/2).
gridDiagonalsCheck.title: Grid Diagonals
